terms.notes: The committed catalogue republishes factual figures only - machine type, vCPU count, memory in GiB, and USD per instance-hour - with attribution to the exact source URLs recorded in the sidecar manifest. No page markup, styling, prose, or image is redistributed. The machine-architecture reference page is published under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License linked from its footer. The project owner approved this redistribution decision; reconfirm it before each schema change.

no_go_conditions: The pricing pages stop rendering their machine-type tables without JavaScript.
The region selector stops publishing role=option with aria-selected and data-value, so a table can no longer be attributed to a region.
A contracted header cell is renamed, which empties the parse and trips the coverage floor.
A published price needs more fractional digits than the contracted maximum.
A Spot machine has no paired On-Demand price, leaving a savings figure with no denominator.
Redistribution of the factual pricing figures can no longer be approved.
